summary: A US television host shared on Instagram a video of a congresswoman that was clearly marked as an AI parody deepfake and criticized her over its content as if it were real. He later deleted the post and acknowledged the error.
technical_summary: A synthetic video depicting a politician was watermarked as a deepfake but was reposted and treated as authentic by a media figure. Failure arose from human credulity and failure to verify provenance despite visible labeling, spreading a misleading political narrative.

summary: A hacker breached an IT software company by texting employees a phishing link and then phoning one of them using an AI-cloned voice to obtain a login code. The breach affected 27 cloud customers.
technical_summary: Attackers combined SMS phishing with a deepfake voice call to extract a multi-factor authentication code, then used cloud-synced authenticator codes in a compromised Google account to reach internal systems. Social engineering plus a design weakness in MFA syncing enabled the intrusion.

summary: Three people died when a car hit a disabled truck on a highway in China after the driver turned on driving assistance and took his hands off the wheel. Investigators found no defect in the assistance system and blamed driver inattention and the truck driver's failures.
technical_summary: A Changan car running an intelligent driving assistance mode at night struck a stationary truck without evasive action. The official investigation attributed the crash to driver distraction and insufficient truck warnings; a system defect was not established, indicating unsafe operator reliance on a driver-assist feature.
